item.title: Harvest Moon: ﻿Echoes of Teradea Reveals Its Roadmap For 2027, Includes Nine DLC Packs & 30th Anniversary Celebration

description.p: The first DLC is now available.The farming and social sim Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea launched for the Switch 1 & 2 earlier this month, and Natsume has now officially revealed a roadmap for the game that runs through to 2027. This will add "nine additional DLC packs" including a special 30th anniversary Harvest Moon celebration.This adventure is set to continue with "new characters, storylines, locations, animals, recipes, upgrades" and much more. The first DLC 'Merus's Dilemma' is available now for $6.99 (or the regional equivalent) and comes with a tools upgrade, six new reciepe, and additional story content.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Nintendo Download: 29th October (North America)

description.p: Hello Kitty! Darkest Dungeon! Peak!The latest Nintendo Download update for North America has arrived, and it's bringing new games galore to the eShop. As always, be sure to drop a vote in our poll and comment down below with your potential picks for the week. Enjoy!Switch 2 eShop - HighlightsMinecraft for Nintendo Switch 2 (Mojang, 27th Oct, $29.99) - Survive the night or create a work of art in the iconic sandbox game! Build anything you can imagine, uncover mysteries and face foes in an infinite world that’s unique in every playthrough. The Nintendo Switch 2 version features the Vibrant Visuals graphics upgrade, which brings improved visual elements, as well as the Super Mario Mash-Up Pack, where you can explore a custom Mario themed world! The pack also features 15 tracks and 40 player skins inspired by the iconic Super Mario series. Those who purchase the Nintendo Switch 2 version can also carry over their save data from the Nintendo Switch. - Read our Minecraft for Nintendo Switch 2 reviewRead the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Pokémon Legends: Z-A's Latest Mystery Gift Distribution Is Now Live

description.p: Spewpa Duper.The catchily-titled 'Pokémon Legends: Z-A - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Mega Dimension' releases today, and to mark the occasion, The Pokémon Company has launched a new Mystery Gift distribution in the game.This one is all about Spewpa and its multi-coloured evolution. Those who redeem the Mystery Gift via the internet between today (29th October) and 19th November at 1:59am UTC will redeem one of the adorable little caterpillar Pokémon for free. But this Spewpa is a special one, since it can evolve into one of 16 different Vivillon patterns that aren't currently available in the Z-A base game.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Feature: 4 Things You Need To Know About Cities: Skylines - Expanded Edition On Nintendo Switch 2

description.p: Can you build the perfect city?Publisher Paradox Interactive recently released Cities: Skylines - Expanded Edition, a significantly revamped version of the original game, on Nintendo Switch 2. With better visuals, performance, and tools, it gives Nintendo Switch 2 players a definitive way to experience the city builder’s impressive scale.If you’re not already familiar with it, Cities: Skylines is an in-depth single-player building sim where you’re mayor of a city that starts as an empty plot of land connected to a nearby highway. It’s up to you to create roads, houses, office buildings, and industrial areas to grow your city while maintaining its infrastructure with power, water, and other services to keep everything running smoothlyRead the full article on nintendolife.com

It was one of many studios hit by cuts from the company on the same day, which supposedly wiped out around 400 jobs.One week on, and several current and former EA employees have anonymously spoken to Vertical Slice about their time at the publisher.
